name: @wrenautomation/kestrel
description: Review the design, not the code. Generates a repo's structure (imports, interfaces, schema, systems) into files in git, diffs it against what you approved, and fails the gate on drift.

scripts.gates: lockf -t 900 /tmp/wren_automation-checks.lock sh -c 'pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test'
